name: Geerling ai-benchmarks: Mac Studio M3 Ultra 512GB, Ollama, DeepSeek-R1-14b (Q4 distill), 51.85 tok/s eval rate, 227W peak
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Jeff Geerling, geerlingguy/ai-benchmarks issue #42, obench.sh on Ollama). Mac Studio M3 Ultra 512GB. DeepSeek-R1-14b Ollama tag. Eval rate 51.85 tok/s; peak system power 227W. Per-request decode, batch 1.
energy_basis: wall power at the plug measured alongside the run; 227W peak reported in the table
notes: Fastest Apple Silicon entry in Geerling's DeepSeek-R1-14b table, but still ~44% slower than the RTX 4090 figure (92.49 tok/s) — the 800GB/s-vs-1TB/s bandwidth gap plus Ollama's CUDA path advantage. Power figure is node-scope wall draw; clocks were not locked (no -lgc equivalent on this Ollama run).
